Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 9
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misattributed the death dates after correct data collection—swapping Victor Schertzinger’s 1941 death with Thomas N. Heffron’s 1951 death. This reversal led to the incorrect conclusion that The Love Charm’s director died earlier, when in fact Schertzinger (The Constant Woman) died earlier.
